findings.proof: For linear f(theta)=theta1+theta2, task A target1 is matched by deltaA; adding orthogonal deltaB changes output to2. Euclidean orthogonality is not a universal retention guarantee.
Invertible reparameterization changes Euclidean update overlap while preserving both functional effects. Functional diagnostics must transform with the Jacobian/metric.
Each sample already has mean0 and variance1; the dataset covariance is singular and has off-diagonal -1. Centering/scaling does not imply covariance identity. An epsilon merely rescales this example.
The anchor Jacobian is zero; the mixed Hessian contribution is nonzero. First-order compatibility alone cannot certify finite nonlinear compositions.
This quadratic example is exact for all eta. Orthogonal initial gradients do not make training updates commute. Adam comparisons additionally need the full optimizer state.

study_implications: Require genuine acquisition evidence before attempting combinations.
Preserve STOP_NO_SIGNAL and failed retention results; geometry cannot overturn them.
Separate weight addition, sequential training order and function composition as different interventions.
Use common exact anchor, frozen arithmetic/runtime and paired per-case retention outcomes.
Prospective function/curvature diagnostics need fresh source-bound budgets and data review; none are dispatched here.
